sources.snippet: Overview meta-llama-3-70b-instruct is a 70 billion parameter language model created by meta and fine-tuned for chat completions and instruction-following tasks. This instruction-tuned variant builds on Llama 3's foundation to handle dialogue, question-answering, and multi-turn conversations more effectively than the base model. The 70B parameter scale positions it as a high-capacity model ...

sources.snippet: Introduction Llama 3.3 is a text-only 70B instruction-tuned model that provides enhanced performance relative to Llama 3.1 70B-and relative to Llama 3.2 90B when used for text-only applications. Moreover, for some applications, Llama 3.3 70B approaches the performance of Llama 3.1 405B.
